paras: 07 Days Delhi, Agra & Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR078
Rs.14999/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Delhi

You are going to visit Delhi, so assume yourself in the vibrant energy of Delhi, a wonderful city where antique history and modernism flawlessly blend. Discover majestic monuments, busy markets, and a different culinary scene.

Upon your arrival at the Railway Station/Airport in Delhi, our representative will warmly welcome you. You will then be escorted to your hotel for check-in. Delhi, being India's capital city, is renowned for its tourist attractions, diverse cuisine, and bustling markets. Take the day to explore on your own.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Delhi.
Day 02 – Delhi Sightseeing
After a hearty breakfast, embark on a tour to explore the iconic attractions of Delhi:
Red Fort - A symbol of India's rich history.
Purana Quila (Old Fort) - Ancient fortress with tales.
Jama Masjid - Magnificent mosque of Delhi.
Qutub Minar - Tower of victory.
India Gate - Memorial honoring soldiers.
Chandni Chowk - Lively market street.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple - Spiritual haven.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Delhi.
Day 03 – Delhi to Agra
Agra is home to the wonderful Taj Mahal, Agra catches attention of visitors with its rich Mughal tradition. Explore grand forts, beautiful gardens, and everlasting architectural wonders.
After breakfast, journey to Agra. Upon arrival and check-in at the hotel, relax before exploring:
Taj Mahal - Timeless symbol of love.
Agra Fort - Mughal architectural gem.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah (Baby Taj) - Elegant marble mausoleum.
Markets & Bazaars - Shopping delights of Agra.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Agra.
Day 04 – Agra to Jaipur

After breakfast, depart for Jaipur. Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
Upon arrival and hotel check-in, relax before an evening exploration of Jaipur's modern attractions:
Statue Circle - Modern city landmark.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Celestial insights.
Vidhan Sabha - Seat of legislative assembly.
Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple) - Marble marvel.
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Cultural hub.
Enjoy a delightful Rajasthani dinner with folk music and dance in a village setting.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 05 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the historic treasures of Jaipur's old city:
Hawa Mahal - Palace of winds.
City Palace - Residence of Jaipur's royalty.
Jantar Mantar (Observatory) - Architectural astronomical instruments.
Jal Mahal - Palace amidst the lake.
Amer Fort - Ancient hilltop fortress.
Nahargarh Fort - Guardian fort of Jaipur.
In the evening, witness the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 06 – Jaipur Day Trip to Pushkar and Ajmer

After breakfast, take a day trip to Ajmer and Pushkar, both important religious sites. Ajmer: A spiritual hub, Ajmer is home to the revered Ajmer Sharif Dargah. Experience the city's rich religious heritage, bustling markets, and serene Ana Sagar Lake.Pushkar is renowned for its sacred Pushkar Lake and the Brahma Temple, Pushkar is a vibrant pilgrimage site. Enjoy the lively Pushkar Camel Fair and the town's bohemian vibe.
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti in Ajmer - Sacred Sufi shrine.
Brahma Temple in Pushkar - Holy shrine of Lord Brahma, the creator.
Return to Jaipur in the evening and relax at the hotel.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 07 – Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, you will be transferred to Jaipur Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. (The Tour Ends)
